# The Tung Tung Tung Sahur

> An independent, fan-made hub of free browser games built around Tung Tung Tung Sahur, the AI-generated meme character created on 28 February 2025 by the Indonesian TikTok user Fernanda Bagas Indrastata (Noxa). Every game is free, runs in a browser with nothing to download, needs no account, and carries no ads.

Key facts about this site:

- One game is live: **Find Tung Tung Tung Sahur**, an audio hide-and-seek game where you track him by sound through a dark village and catch him before dawn. Three modes: Classic (no timer), Sahur Rush (beat the dawn clock) and Daily Sahur (five shared hiding spots per day, with a streak).
- It is **not** a horror, clicker, obby or shooter game. Those Tung Tung Tung Sahur games exist, but they are made by unrelated developers and hosted elsewhere.
- All artwork is original; all audio is synthesized live in the browser with the Web Audio API. Nothing is downloaded.
- Fully playable with the sound off via Visual Cues. Supports mouse, touch and keyboard, screen reader announcements and reduced motion.
- Progress is stored in the visitor's browser only. No accounts and no ads. Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity are used to measure which games get played.
- Unofficial and unaffiliated with the creator of the meme.

## Games

- [Find Tung Tung Tung Sahur](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/games/find-tung-tung-tung-sahur): the live game — how to play, controls, the three modes, tips, supported devices and an FAQ.
- [All games](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/games): the full list, including titles still in development.

## The character

- [Who Is Tung Tung Tung Sahur?](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/tung-tung-tung-sahur): what the name means (kentongan + sahur), who created him and when, why he is Indonesian rather than Italian despite the "Italian brainrot" label, the three-calls lore, alternative spellings, and a table disambiguating the different Tung Tung Tung Sahur games that exist.

## Questions

- [FAQ](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/faq): ~40 answers grouped into the name and its meaning (tung, sahur, kentongan, how many tungs, Triple T), origin and ownership (Noxa, DALL·E, the Mementum Lab vs Spyder Games copyright dispute and whether he is public domain), the lore and the character, Ramadan and whether the meme offends anyone, the Steal a Brainrot and Roblox removals plus the Fortnite skin, and how to play the games here.

## Site

- [About](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/about): who made this and how it is built.
- [Contact](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/contact): the one email address for bug reports, game ideas, accessibility issues and rights or press enquiries — plus what this site cannot help with (other developers' Tung Tung Tung Sahur games, Steal a Brainrot items, licensing the character).
- [Privacy](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/privacy): what is stored and where.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://thetungtungtungsahur.com/terms): free to play, unofficial fan work, original artwork and code, what you may do with it (screenshots, video and streaming are fine; re-hosting is not), and the site offered as-is.
